purpose: Reusable Pattern Lab thumbnail format memory. Use this to preserve owner-liked formats intentionally without letting them become the only creative lane.

rules.normal_ab_test_lane: Use owner-liked formats when testing wording, source image, or topic promise while holding layout mostly constant.
rules.unique_topic_lane: Use topic-specific unique formats when the story has a distinctive proof object, event, system, or visual metaphor that should not fit a generic city template.
rules.reuse_limit: Do not use the same liked format for more than one thumbnail in a unique-topic set unless the owner explicitly asks for an AB test.
rules.promotion_rule: Only promote a format to liked after owner rating or strong performance evidence. Local passing gates are necessary but not sufficient.
rules.city_name_required: Every Pattern Lab thumbnail must include the active city name as primary or co-primary readable text. No exception for unique-topic thumbnails.
rules.no_random_arrows: Arrows are blocked unless they point to a concrete route, flow, before-after direction, or labeled source feature. Decorative/random arrows fail owner review.
rules.photo_diversity: Unique-topic sets must use materially different relevant photos across the three thumbnails when source media allows it; repeated photos are allowed only for intentional AB tests.
rules.text_contrast: Every public word must remain readable at search-shelf size; avoid heavy shadow/outline that fights the fill color.
rules.hook_first_brief_required: Every rendered thumbnail must have a hook-first brief with city, click question, emotional tension, proof object, source tags, exact hook text, forbidden elements, and first-30-second payoff.
rules.pre_render_click_score: Do not render concepts below 8/10 average across curiosity, clarity, source/photo fit, visual novelty, title-thumbnail promise, and first-30-second payoff.
rules.intentionality_gate: Every line, arrow, box, divider, prop, and public word must be purpose-labeled; unexplained elements fail owner review.
rules.liked_format_reuse: Owner-liked formats are AB-test assets, not default templates; unique-topic batches must vary proof object, photo, hook, and composition unless explicitly labeled AB test.

do_not_use_for: unique event thumbnails where a stronger story object exists
all three selected candidates in a topic
stories with one strong proof object

reject_reasons_v2.random_arrow: Arrow is decorative or not tied to a concrete route, flow, or source feature.
reject_reasons_v2.unexplained_line: Line/divider appears without a source/story purpose.
reject_reasons_v2.weak_topic: Topic lacks enough curiosity, conflict, visual proof, or source availability.
reject_reasons_v2.generic_photo: Photo does not directly support the hook.
reject_reasons_v2.city_missing: City name is missing from the thumbnail/brief.
reject_reasons_v2.text_over_text: Public text overlaps or competes with other text.
reject_reasons_v2.unreadable_text: Text is not readable at search-shelf size.
reject_reasons_v2.fake_proof: Visual implies proof that is not real source-backed evidence.
reject_reasons_v2.decorative_black_box: Box/backplate is decorative or unlabeled instead of supporting readability or source context.

do_not_use_cases: every topic in a unique set
liked_formats_v2.allowed_variation_range: change hook, source photo, color, and crop; preserve map-plus-city logic only for AB tests
liked_formats_v2.owner_rating_source: owner rated map/redrawn examples highly and requested controlled reuse only

liked_formats_v2.required_proof_object: document prop with readable sentence fragments and whole-word redactions
liked_formats_v2.allowed_variation_range: may change document scale/crop; must keep real sentence fragments visible
liked_formats_v2.owner_rating_source: owner liked redacted concept only when redactions were selective and intentional

liked_formats_v2.required_proof_object: dominant real city photo matching the hook
liked_formats_v2.allowed_variation_range: change crop, headline, proof object, and contrast; do not reuse as blind template
liked_formats_v2.owner_rating_source: owner explicitly rejected design-only mockups when real photos exist

typography_v1.rule: Use role-based modern condensed typography for city anchors and main hooks; Impact is last fallback only.
typography_v1.owner_feedback_basis: Owner says current main-title fonts are not great and Pattern Lab must learn from successful channels while keeping city/source-first discipline.
